desc:
The Psychological Experiment is a single-player horror game. As a patient in a mental asylum, you are confined in isolation, distant from everything, suffering from hallucinations and delusions. This test will evaluate your mental status and psychological well-being. Are you okay? Is everything what it seems to be? Are you awake?

Latest Update
- New Level: The Institute (Level 4)

⚠️ WARNING: This game contains loud noises, flashing lights, and sudden jumpscares.

🎧 For the best gameplay experience, we recommend wearing headphones and being fully immersed (no outside distractions)


Found a bug or have any suggestions? Join our community and let us know.
